# BF Jira Comment Template

Use this when posting an investigation summary directly to a BF ticket via `jira_add_comment`.
Always show the user the exact comment text and get confirmation before posting.

---

```
h2. AI-Assisted Investigation Summary

*Generated by wt-analyze — review before acting.*

h3. Failure Classification
||Field||Value||
|Type|<Crash / Assertion / Hang / Corruption / Flaky / Infra>|
|Subsystem|<e.g. checkpoint, eviction, txn>|
|First error|{{<exact error line>}}|

h3. Root Cause Hypothesis
<One paragraph. What failed, where, and the most likely why.>

*Confidence:* Low / Medium / High
*Key uncertainty:* <what would change the conclusion>

h3. Evidence
* EVG task: <task ID or Spruce URL>
* Relevant log lines: {{<excerpt>}}
* Related tickets: <BF-XXXXX, SERVER-XXXXX>
* Recurrence (7d): <N failures across M variants>

h3. Recommended Next Action
<e.g. "Reproduce locally with test/format using CONFIG attached to EVG task XYZ, then bisect to the checkpoint refactor in WT-XXXXX.">

----
_This comment was generated with AI assistance via the wt-bbb-bot. Commands should be
verified before execution._
```
